verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is an issuing docs page saying you can force verification checks to fail when testing error handling. That implies the platform runs its own verification checks with failure states, but the pack never names KYC or KYB. Missing for 10: explicit KYC for consumers and KYB for businesses, documented data requirements, review states, re-verification flows, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, cardholder verification is built into issuance — KYC for consumers and KYB for businesses run through the platform with documented data requirements, review states, and re-verification flows

citations.quote: To test your error handling flow, you can force a scenario where one or more verification checks fail.
